title: A herald has to come from the memory
thesis: A herald has to come from the memory that holds the thing, at the moment it holds it. A herald that survives its write is a false receipt with a timestamp.
style: Calm, precise, instrument-like. Dark near-black field, thin cyan and green light, fine grid, slow fog. Restrained, documentary, no spectacle.

beats.caption: A herald has to come from the memory that holds the thing,

shot.subject: A single point of cyan light suspended inside a dark glass cell, faint grid behind it
shot.camera: locked-off medium shot, slow 5 percent push-in
shot.motion: the light pulses once, softly, then holds
shot.light: low key, the point is the only source

beats.caption: at the moment it holds it.

shot.subject: The same light, now steady, a thin green line drawn from it toward the edge of frame
shot.motion: the line extends at an even pace and stops
shot.light: light from the line itself, nothing else

beats.caption: A herald that survives its write

shot.subject: The green line alone in fog, still glowing, connected to nothing
shot.camera: slow lateral drift left to right
shot.motion: fog moves across the line, the line does not change
shot.light: the line as sole source, cold fog

beats.caption: is a false receipt with a timestamp.

shot.subject: The line resolves into a thin paper slip with an unreadable printed mark, lying on a dark surface
shot.motion: a faint red edge-light traces the slip once
